title: Convolution against a probability density
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ be the Boolean cube, and let $\varphi:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$ be pointwise nonnegative with uniform expectation $1$. For every function $g:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$ and every $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, the convolution of $\varphi$ and $g$ at $x$ equals both the $\varphi$-weighted expectation of $y\mapsto g(x-y)$ and the $\varphi$-weighted expectation of $y\mapsto g(x+y)$.
